subject.title: feat: add portable table presentation blocks

question: Should `table` become a permanent public portable presentation block with the proposed caption, headers, rows, numeric-cell, and fallback semantics?
rationale: The new union member and exports become a released third-party plugin SDK commitment that implementation tests cannot choose on maintainers' behalf.

options.title: Approve portable tables
options.body: Accept the generic contract, then require a rebase and live Slack native/fallback proof before merge.

options.title: Keep tables Slack-private
options.body: Narrow the work to Slack-owned rendering and defer the cross-channel public API commitment.

recommendation.title: Approve portable tables
